purpose: Teach: みなす/逃れる/しようが/見なさ/傾き/負い/懲り/劣る

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは翔くんを大人とみなす日も近いわね
lines.en: Sho, I think the day your father sees you as grown up is getting close.
lines.style: Warm, slightly wistful. Soft pace. The tone of someone watching time pass. Gentle certainty, not pushing — observing aloud to herself as much as to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題から逃れる事は絶対しないよ
lines.en: Mom, I promise I'll never try to get out of my homework.
lines.style: Quiet, steady conviction. No performance — just simple honesty. Slight pause before the commitment, like he's thinking it through as he says it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「しようがない」と笑っていらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was laughing about it — said there's nothing to be done.
lines.style: Light amusement with an undercurrent of affection. Slight knowingness in the delivery. Not mocking — amused at the situation, not at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんからぼくが見なされてないって心配だよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm worried that Dad doesn't really notice me.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Not defensive — genuinely uncertain. The vulnerability of a small child checking if he's being seen. Trailing off slightly, like he's afraid of the answer.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の写真の傾きを直しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's straighten the picture frame in your room, shall we?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. Practical redirection. Not dismissing what he said — noticing it and gently moving them both toward action. Clear, calm instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが責任を負い続けてらっしゃると思うよ
lines.en: Mom, I think Dad is still taking responsibility for what he did wrong.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant for his age. Not accusing — noticing. Slow delivery. He's piecing something together as he speaks. Quiet wisdom.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、悪さに懲りた様子のお父さんが微笑ましいわ
lines.en: Sho, it's sweet to see your father learning from his mistakes.
lines.style: Soft affection. A little bit of a smile in the voice. Genuine, not performed. The tenderness of someone watching a person she loves trying to be better.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに劣ると思わずに頑張るよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to work hard and not feel like I'm less than Dad.
lines.style: Determined but gentle. The effort of a small boy saying something he needs to believe. A little breathless with the weight of it. Growing resolve.
